name: humanizer-gate
description: Runs humanizer detection on prose as it leaves the session: markdown writes get a status line, PR bodies and commit messages can be held for a yes/no when an error-level pattern shows up.

holdOnError.title: Hold PR bodies on errors
holdOnError.description: Ask before a create_pull_request or update_pull_request call whose body has an error-level finding. Off reports in the status line only.

holdOnCommitError.title: Hold commits on errors
holdOnCommitError.description: Ask before a git commit whose message has an error-level finding. Off by default: commit bodies are short and belt already guards commits.

minSeverity.title: Minimum severity
minSeverity.description: The lowest severity humanizer detect reports; suggestion counts everything.
